o.text:
From izafet II compound of maddə (“substance, matter”) + mübadilə (“exchange”).
Calque of Russian обме́н веще́ств (obmén veščéstv).
Borrowed from Russian агрономия (agronomija). By surface analysis, aqro- + -nomiya.
